subject: english
chapter_title: Mijbil the Otter: A Pet in Camusfearna and London

concepts.title: Mijbil's Arrival at Camusfearna
concepts.definition: After the death of his dog Jonnie, Gavin Maxwell decides to keep an otter instead; a friend sends him one from the Tigris marshes, and the creature, named Mijbil, emerges from a sack at the Consulate-General in Basra looking like a medievally-conceived dragon coated in mud.
concepts.key_idea: Mijbil belongs to a race previously unknown to science, later christened by zoologists Lutrogale perspicillata maxwelli, or Maxwell's otter, and for the first twenty-four hours he stays aloof and indifferent.

solution_steps.explain: Loneliness after Jonnie's death and the memory that otters from the Tigris marshes are often tamed by Arabs led Maxwell to want one.
At the Consulate-General in Basra, two Arabs delivered a squirming sack with a note from Maxwell's friend saying, here is your otter.
Maxwell called him Mijbil, and zoologists later named the race Lutrogale perspicillata maxwelli after the author.

concepts.title: Mijbil's Playfulness and Compulsive Habits
concepts.definition: Mijbil shows the intelligence and fun of otters: he juggles marbles on his chest, turns the bathroom tap, rolls and splashes in water, and develops compulsive habits like racing up the wall of the bathtub.
concepts.key_idea: Within twenty-four hours Mijbil had tamed the bathroom tap, a game of screwing and unscrewing that shows his curiosity and learning power.

solution_steps.explain: Juggling marbles between paws and chest, plunging and rolling in water, and nuzzling Maxwell.
Habits of repeated action, like school children on escalators and Mij racing the tub wall, done for their own sake.
Mij learned to turn the tap so water flowed into the tub, showing curiosity mastered within a day.

concepts.title: The Journey to England in a Box
concepts.definition: To fly with Mij to England, Maxwell faced airline rules against animals loose in the cabin, so he packed the otter in a box; Mij tore the metal lining, bloodied himself, and then escaped in the aeroplane cabin.
concepts.key_idea: On board, Mij vanished, then nuzzled Maxwell's face and neck, and later sat on the air hostess's knee, winning over the passengers.

solution_steps.explain: The airline allowed Mij only if packed in a box not exceeding eighteen inches square.
Mij tore the metal lining and cut himself, and later slipped out in the cabin during the flight.
The air hostess soothed Maxwell, and Mij sat quietly, drenched but safe, until London.

concepts.title: Londoners' Guesses about Mij
concepts.definition: Walking Mij through London, Maxwell met a stream of conjectural questions: people guessed the otter was a baby seal, a squirrel, a walrus, a beaver, a leopard or even a brontosaurus.
concepts.key_idea: The guesses show how little city people knew of otters, and a labourer's blunt question, what is that, summed up the barrage of conjecture.

solution_steps.explain: Baby seal, squirrel, walrus, beaver, leopard, brontosaurus, a tiger even, were all suggested.
The guesses came as a barrage of conjectural questions, showing surprise and curiosity.
Mij belonged to a race of otters found in the Tigris marshes, later named Maxwell's otter after the author.
